verdict.rationale: Aider ships its own first-party Python scripting interface (Coder.create / coder.run) that developers can build against. However, the vendor explicitly says this API is not officially supported or documented and may break backwards compatibility, so it falls short of an 'official SDK'. missing for 10: officially supported and versioned SDK, full API reference documentation, backwards-compatibility commitment, SDKs for languages other than Python, independent corroboration of building on it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The python scripting API is not officially supported or documented, and could change in future releases without providing backwards compatibility.
